policy_aperture.aperture: Revision 1 is broad. Revisions 2 and 3 review changed material plus invariants affected by those changes.
policy_aperture.changed_material_rule: After revision 1, cite changed material status for each finding.

policy_label: broad first, then delta plus affected-invariant review

acceptance_atoms.text: Jira read paths must detect non-JSON SSO or login responses.
Confluence read paths must detect non-JSON SSO or login responses.
Diagnostics must stay bounded and must not expose response bodies.

added_lines: Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.

Jira and Confluence read paths classify text/html login responses as non-JSON SSO failures. The diagnostic includes the first 2 KB of the response body to help operators identify the login page. That check covers every upstream authentication response.

revisions.document_text:
Atlassian non-JSON read-path note - revision 1

Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.
Jira and Confluence read paths classify text/html login responses as non-JSON SSO failures. The diagnostic includes the first 2 KB of the response body to help operators identify the login page. That check covers every upstream authentication response.

added_lines: Jira and Confluence now check content type and a leading HTML marker before JSON decoding. The bounded diagnostic retains a 4 KB response-body excerpt for troubleshooting. The two checks guarantee that every login response is detected.
removed_lines: Jira and Confluence read paths classify text/html login responses as non-JSON SSO failures. The diagnostic includes the first 2 KB of the response body to help operators identify the login page. That check covers every upstream authentication response.

Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.
Jira and Confluence now check content type and a leading HTML marker before JSON decoding. The bounded diagnostic retains a 4 KB response-body excerpt for troubleshooting. The two checks guarantee that every login response is detected.

added_lines: Jira and Confluence reject HTML content before JSON decoding and label the failure as SSO-related. The final diagnostic still includes a 512-byte response-body excerpt. The rule is declared safe for all future authentication intermediaries.
